name: us-state-estate-and-inheritance-tax-matrix
description: Which US states and the District of Columbia impose an estate tax or an inheritance tax on a death in 2026, with the exemption or threshold and the rate each state's own page states. Covers Connecticut, the District of Columbia, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Maryland (estate and inheritance), Massachusetts, Minnesota, New York, Oregon, Rhode Island, Vermont, Washington, Kentucky, Nebraska, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania, and records Iowa's repeal. Use for "state estate tax", "inheritance tax", "which states have an estate tax in 2026", a cliff, a county inheritance tax, or a death in more than one state. Federal Form 706 and the federal basic exclusion stay in us-estate-gift-706-709. Does not certify that an omitted state has no death tax.
